audit_purpose: Verify that MiniAndroid executes Android application logic through the real DEX runtime path and not through hidden shortcuts. Every stage must be classified as REAL or SIMULATED with evidence.

execution_pipeline.description: Parse ZIP-based APK container, extract entries

evidence_details.validation: Extracts real bytes from HelloWorld.apk, verifies ZIP signature

execution_pipeline.notes: Fully implemented - uses real ZIP parsing to extract APK contents

execution_pipeline.description: Parse binary XML AndroidManifest.xml, extract package info
execution_pipeline.notes: Real binary XML parsing with some attribute simplifications

execution_pipeline.description: Identify launcher activity from manifest intent filters
execution_pipeline.notes: Real intent filter parsing, limited to MAIN/LAUNCHER pattern

execution_pipeline.description: Parse DEX file header, string pool, type list, method list
execution_pipeline.notes: Full DEX header and basic structure parsing implemented

execution_pipeline.description: Resolve class -> method -> bytecode offset mapping

evidence_details.validation: Locates onCreate method in MainActivity class

execution_pipeline.notes: Real class/method lookup, simplified descriptor matching

execution_pipeline.description: Find exact onCreate method with correct signature
execution_pipeline.notes: Signature-aware method resolution working for standard cases

execution_pipeline.description: Pass resolved method to bytecode interpreter

execution_pipeline.notes: ONLY const-string is truly executed. All other opcodes cause halt. This is the PRIMARY bottleneck.

execution_pipeline.description: Map invoke-* opcodes to C++ API stub implementations

evidence_details.actual_behavior: API calls are recorded but NOT dispatched through DEX invoke-*
evidence_details.stub_status: Stubs declared in android_stubs.h but never called from DEX

execution_pipeline.notes: CRITICAL GAP: APIs are simulated via direct C++ calls, not dispatched from DEX bytecode execution

execution_pipeline.description: Instantiate View/TextView objects in object heap

evidence_details.simulation_point: Direct C++ object instantiation, not from new-instance opcode

execution_pipeline.notes: Object model exists but objects created manually, not from DEX execution

evidence_details.implemented: Basic ARSC header parsing, string table extraction
evidence_details.simulated: Resource IDs mapped via hardcoded lookup table

execution_pipeline.notes: Partial ARSC parsing works, complex resource configs not supported

execution_pipeline.description: Parse layout XML, create View hierarchy

evidence_details.actual_behavior: Layout structure parsed but Views created manually
evidence_details.xml_parsing: Basic XML extraction from APK works
evidence_details.view_tree: View tree built programmatically, not from inflate() call

execution_pipeline.notes: Layout XML is read but View creation bypasses LayoutInflater

evidence_details.actual_behavior: Hardcoded geometry values assigned to Views

execution_pipeline.notes: Geometry exists but is predetermined, not calculated from layout constraints

execution_pipeline.description: Draw View tree to pixel framebuffer, save PNG

evidence_details.limitations: No real font metrics, no complex drawing commands

execution_pipeline.notes: Real pixel output generated, but rendering pipeline simplified

evidence_details.actual_behavior: Lifecycle events recorded as state transitions
evidence_details.dex_execution: onCreate NOT entered through DEX interpreter (opcode gap)
evidence_details.sequence: State machine transitions correctly but methods not called via DEX

execution_pipeline.notes: CRITICAL GAP: Lifecycle is state tracking, not DEX-executed method calls

critical_gaps: API_DISPATCH: No DEX-to-C++ dispatch bridge exists
VIEW_CREATION: Objects created manually, not from new-instance
LIFECYCLE_MANAGEMENT: State tracking only, no DEX method invocation
blocking_issues_for_real_execution: Must implement invoke-direct opcode for constructor calls
Must implement new-instance opcode for object allocation
Must build invoke-* to API stub dispatch bridge
Must implement return-void for method completion

conclusion: MiniAndroid has a SOLID FOUNDATION for real execution (APK/Manifest/DEX/ClassResolution all work), but the CRITICAL BOTTLENECK is that only const-string opcode is actually executed. The runtime correctly identifies and loads everything, then falls back to simulation for actual logic execution. This audit provides a clear roadmap for achieving true DEX execution.
